title: magnolia macrophylla subsp. ashei
intro: Magnolia macrophylla subsp. ashei, commonly known as the Ashei magnolia, is a subspecies of deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the magnolia family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Magnolia macrophylla subsp. ashei are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, and are used to treat various health issues, including anxiety and sleep disorders. Research on the bioactive constituents of this plant has shown that it may contain limonoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
